verdict.rationale: Munito's own docs list integration guides for coding agents (Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, Hermes) and agent frameworks (LangChain, LlamaIndex). They also document OpenAI- and Anthropic-compatible APIs where switching only requires changing the base URL, key and model ID. The evidence is index-level mentions, so the depth of each guide is not shown. Missing for 10: content or depth of the individual agent/framework guides, independent or hands-on corroboration that these integrations work.
